sentences: Double-precision reciprocal (`OpFDiv %double 1.0 x`), inverse square root (`GLSL.std.450 InverseSqrt`), and square root (`GLSL.std.450 Sqrt`), requiring `Float64` (`shaderFloat64`).

VOP3 input modifiers (`abs`, `neg`) apply to the double operand, and output modifiers (`mul:2`, `mul:4`, `div:2`, then `clamp` to [0, 1]) apply via `clamp_mods_f64` (LLVM `VOP1Inst` / `VOP_F64_F64` in `VOP1Instructions.td`, `HasClamp` and `HasOMod` via `VOPProfile`).
Special-value edge cases (`±0`, negative inputs, NaN) follow the driver's SPIR-V `OpFDiv`/`InverseSqrt`/`Sqrt` rules, as for the f32 forms.
